summary: Tested Revoked-Repo Banner + Auto-Reconnect feature (2026-08-20). All 5 backend pytest tests PASS. Frontend banner renders correctly inside chat pane on disconnected demo project (aurem-demo/frontend) with correct reason text 'token rejected — access revoked or expired'. Reconnect GitHub App button is clickable, opens the /github/app/install popup, and does not throw JS errors. PATCH /cto/projects/{id} with installation_id correctly sets auth_method='github_app' and persists installation_id (verified via GET). Regression on existing PATCH fields (branch, tech_stack, preview_url) still works.

backend_pytest: test_patch_installation_id_sets_auth_method — PASS (verified auth_method='github_app', installation_id=987654321 persisted via GET, restored)
frontend_playwright: Login → dashboard: banner data-testid='revoked-repo-banner' visible with text 'GitHub access revoked for aurem-demo/frontend (token rejected — access revoked or expired) — reconnect to keep chatting.'
Click opens popup to /api/aurem-dev/github/app/install?auth=<token>; button flips to 'Reconnecting…' state; page did not crash; 0 JS console/page errors captured
Banner still visible post-click (correct — still disconnected until real OAuth completes)

banner_absent_case_note: Could not create a genuinely 'connected' project on this preview account: all 23 existing projects are disconnected, the user's stored OAuth token is a placeholder ('ghp_bogus_iter330_harness') so repo_status._check_one 401s even against a public repo. Verified by code review only — RevokedRepoBanner.jsx line 114: `if (status !== 'disconnected') return null;` unambiguously prevents rendering for 'connected' status. This is a trivial single-branch condition with no additional logic to break.
regression_repo_context_note: services/repo_context.py GithubAuthError + services/local_tools.py _github_access_revoked_error helper + read_repo_file/read_repo_files/list_repo_files catch-blocks verified in place via grep (all imports and catch clauses present). Not re-run E2E since main agent already unit-verified same-day.
critical_code_review_comments: RevokedRepoBanner.jsx polls /connection-status every 30s per visible tab — combined with the sidebar's own poll this is 2 requests per 30s per user. Backend caches for 8s so cost is bounded, but on the founder's account with 23 projects the endpoint fans out to ~23 GitHub API calls per uncached poll. Not a bug — worth noting for capacity planning.
reconnect() polls /github/app/installations every 1.5s for up to 180s after popup opens (up to 120 requests). Acceptable for a rare user action but ensure that endpoint is cheap.
PATCH endpoint's `updates = {k: v for ... if v is not None and v != ''}` strips 0 as falsy for int fields only via '!= ""' check — installation_id=0 would still pass (int 0 != ''), which is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use pre-existing demo projects (p_demo_a aurem-demo/frontend). PATCH tests restore original field values in a finally block.
